text:
incident-bot: Pager: routing.failures.euw1 · SEV=P1 · spike in 5xx and misroutes for eu-west-1 routing tier-A. Estimated impact: ~10% of Dedicated requests, increased latency and token errors. Paging on-call.

alice-oncall: ack — I'm on call for EU. Looking into initial alerts. :rotating_light:

ben-sre: I'm up. Can you confirm start time and any recent routing-policy changes?

alice-oncall: Start ~2026-03-14 02:13:xx UTC per metrics. There was a policy push at 02:05 from policy-service to add a spillover rule for tier-A -> prefer-model: low-latency-variants. Attaching logs below.

alice-oncall: ```
2026-03-14T02:05:12Z policy-service INFO apply_policy user=deploy-bot id=ps-9384 change=spillover:enable target=tier-A prefer=ll-variants
2026-03-14T02:12:58Z routing-proxy WARN misroute count=42 path=/v1/chat model=requested:rm-turbo -> routed:ll-quant-v1
2026-03-14T02:13:01Z routing-proxy ERROR 502 downstream=runtime reason=kv-cache-mismatch
```

carla-prod: We're seeing customer complaints — timeouts then some 502s and weird tokenization errors when requests hit the fallback models. Customer impact: degraded throughput for a handful of enterprise tenants.

dave-runtime: quick note: ll-quant-v1 has a different tokenizer/quantization path. If a routing decision sends request with prefix KV cache primed for rm-turbo, we get cache mismatch exceptions. That explains the 502 + downstream errors.

ben-sre: hypothesis 1 — policy-service pushed spillover that prefers low-latency quantized variants for tier-A. Those variants are not compatible with existing KV cache/sequence-length assumptions -> misroutes -> tokenization/kv cache errors -> 502s.

ben-sre: hypothesis 2 — simultaneous rolling restart of routing-proxy nodes (02:04–02:08) caused transient stale policy state during the push, amplifying misroutes. Need to verify sync between policy-service and proxies.

alice-oncall: mitigation plan (live):
1) revert policy spillover change (policy-service rollback).
2) temporarily disable cross-region spillover for eu-west-1.
3) route critical customers to eu-central fallback cluster.
4) collect logs + KV cache dump for affected proxies for RCA.

sasha-platform: running rollback now. Command: ```./policyctl rollback --change ps-9384 --reason "misroute spike" --force```

infra-bot: policy-service rollback started by sasha-platform at 2026-03-14T02:22:14Z

infra-bot: policy-service rollback completed successfully at 2026-03-14T02:23:02Z (change ps-9384 reverted)

alice-oncall: disabling spillover for eu-west-1: ```./routingctl set-spillover --region eu-west-1 --enable false``` executed 02:24 UTC.

ben-sre: rerouting critical traffic to eu-central: updating routing weight on lb. Command: ```kubectl patch svc routing-eu --patch '{"spec":{"traffic":{"eu-west-1":70,"eu-central-1":30}}}'``` — applied 02:28 UTC. :white_check_mark:

dave-runtime: runtime teams are pulling KV caches from affected nodes. Sample KV mismatch trace: ```
[02:13:01Z] proxy=rp-12 error=KVCacheMismatch prefix=usr:acct:42 expected-v=984 got-v=0
[02:13:01Z] runtime rt-7 request_id=aa3b tokenization_err mismatched-tok-set ll-quant-v1 vs rm-turbo
```

pradeep-eng: collecting logs + tarball now: ```scp rp-12:/var/log/routing/*.log /tmp/rp-12-logs && tar czf /tmp/rp-12-logs.tgz /tmp/rp-12-logs``` — will upload to /artifacts/incidents/1843456789/ in ~15m.

alice-oncall: timeline (so far):
- 02:05 UTC: policy-service push ps-9384 (spillover enable prefer=ll-variants)
- 02:04–02:08 UTC: routing-proxy rolling restart window (coord with infra)
- 02:12 UTC: first misroute warnings spike
- 02:13 UTC: 502s + KV cache mismatch errors escalate to SEV P1
- 02:22 UTC: rollback initiated
- 02:23 UTC: rollback completed
- 02:24–02:28 UTC: spillover disabled + partial reroute to eu-central

emily-pm: can we quantify customer impact? numbers of affected requests, tenants, any SLO breaches?

alice-oncall: preliminary numbers from metrics: ~8–12% increased 5xx in eu-west-1 over 25 mins, 4 tenants had >3% request loss, latency p95 increased 270ms -> we will compute billing/incident impact after logs.

carla-prod: also flagging that a Managed Dedicated customer reported a session-level failure that led to degraded UX; ops is engaged to notify them.

ben-sre: next actions for RCA:
- collect policy-service audit logs for ps-9384 (who triggered, automated vs human)
- gather routing-proxy state dumps (policy hash, synced policies) at time of misroute
- check rollout window for routing-proxy restart to see if race existed
- validate model-compatibility table for ll-quant-v1 vs rm-turbo (tokenizer/kvseed compatibility)

sasha-platform: taking ownership of post-incident RCA. Owner: sasha-platform. Assignees: ben-sre (routing), dave-runtime (model compatibility), pradeep-eng (logs/artifacts), carla-prod (customer comms).

alice-oncall: I'm handing off -> off-call. sasha-platform, please continue coordination and produce a timeline + root-cause doc. 

sasha-platform: ack — taking over. I'll create the RCA doc and invite stakeholders. Immediate hypothesis is policy-service ordering + rolling restart race leading to inconsistent policy state on proxies that accepted spillover preference for incompatible model variants.

ben-sre: questions for policy-service team: does policy application have a transactional sync? If not, add a pre-check for model-compat before enabling cross-tier spillover.

dave-runtime: agree — we need compatibility gating (model tokenizer hash match + runtime flag) before policy can prefer a model. Also add automated canary traffic to new spillover rules.

pradeep-eng: artifact upload complete: /artifacts/incidents/1843456789/rp-12-logs.tgz + policy-audit-ps-9384.json uploaded.

emily-pm: I'll start drafting a customer-facing summary and postmortem timeline. Notify me if we confirm tenants impacted and exact TTL of errors.

carla-prod: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with Ops to ensure the affected customers get the incident notification and mitigation steps.

sasha-platform: final live note: no further spikes observed in the last 30m after rollback and disable. We'll keep monitoring for 6 hours. Creating RCA doc now and will ping this thread with the link when ready. :mag_right:
